utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — I’m still pinning down the exact time, but I’d love your help spreading the word and being there when we kick it off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — could you point me to the first repair drive location to check? I’ll keep an eye on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need at the first location.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We could really use hands sorting donations and a few folks to shuttle supplies. If you’re free, swing by Saturday morning and I’ll point you to the busiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks—please check the church parking lot first and let me know if any drop-off tables have been set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — before I help, can you remind me which parts need fixing on the drive? I remember the gate and a couple lane markers, but I want to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What does it need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hands and a clear list of the next jobs. What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure — folks are already talking up donations and tool drops. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, just let me know what you need and when to show up. I can help with donations or tool drops.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know what tools we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at the community center on Maple sounds workable, but I’d still like a firmer time and drop-off order before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still aiming for Saturday morning, and the drop-off is at the community center on Maple. I’ll let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll plan on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — I’m still sorting the last bits, but I could use help with the simple stuff. I’ll send you what’s left to do.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—it’s the gate and a couple of the lane markers, I think. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort the list if you want—maybe check which gate parts and lane markers still need fixing.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
